title.zh: VLA 评测：从跑通到可靠比较

category.zh: 模型评测 · 性能分析

summary.zh: 围绕具身模型的仿真评测，参与并发配置、推理微批处理和结果审计。把吞吐、资源占用与评测完整性放在一起检查。
summary.en: I contribute to embodied-model evaluation through concurrency tuning, inference micro-batching, and result auditing, examining throughput, resource use, and evaluation completeness together.

highlight.zh: 一次 500-episode 对比：55.8 → 32.0 分钟

question.zh: 怎样缩短模型评测的等待时间，同时保留清楚的实验条件和完整结果？
question.en: How can evaluation finish sooner while keeping its experimental conditions and results auditable?

work.zh: 参与 LIBERO、RoboTwin2 等仿真环境的评测执行，跟进模型服务、工作进程和结果产出。
work.en: Run and monitor evaluations in simulation environments including LIBERO and RoboTwin2, following model services, workers, and result artifacts.

work.zh: 对比评测并发与推理微批配置，记录耗时、显存、利用率和异常，不只观察服务是否启动。
work.en: Compare evaluator concurrency and inference micro-batching, recording elapsed time, memory, utilization, and failures rather than relying only on service readiness.

work.zh: 检查 episode 唯一性、覆盖范围、重复与缺失，保留失败原因及补跑记录。
work.en: Audit episode identity and coverage, detect duplicates and omissions, and preserve failures and recovery records.

experiment.zh: 2026 年 7 月的 DM0 / LIBERO Spatial 对比，10 个任务 × 50 episodes，共 500 episodes；seed 7，推理端使用单张 RTX 4090D。配置由 2 个评测 worker、无微批，调整到 10 个 worker、batch 4、等待 20 ms；55.8 与 32.0 分钟使用该次记录的 wall time 口径。
experiment.en: A July 2026 comparison of DM0 on LIBERO Spatial: 10 tasks × 50 episodes, seed 7, with one RTX 4090D for inference. The configuration changes from 2 evaluator workers without batching to 10 workers with batch 4 and a 20 ms wait. The 55.8- and 32.0-minute values use the wall-time measure in that experiment record.

label.zh: 服务 GPU 平均利用率

boundary.zh: 这是指定模型、环境与配置下的单 seed 性能结果。它不代表模型成功率提升，也不能直接推广为所有任务的加速比。更高并发还需权衡显存和内存开销。
boundary.en: This is a single-seed performance result for a specific model, environment, and configuration. It is not a model success-rate improvement or a universal speedup. Higher concurrency also requires a memory trade-off.

reflection.zh: 我逐渐把“运行完成”理解成一组可核对的条件：进程结束、结果落盘、覆盖完整、错误解释清楚，再讨论性能。
reflection.en: I increasingly treat completion as a set of checks: the run has terminated, artifacts are saved, coverage is complete, and errors are accounted for. Performance comes after those checks.

title.zh: NexArm：采集、转码与数据完整性
title.en: NexArm: capture, transcoding, and data integrity

category.zh: 机器人数据 · 系统工程

summary.zh: 参与机械臂多相机采集链路和后台转码工具开发，关注持续写入、队列行为、时间戳及派生文件的一致性。
summary.en: I contribute to multi-camera capture and background transcoding for robot data, focusing on sustained writes, queue behavior, timestamps, and consistency of derived files.

highlight.zh: 同两条录制：转码等待时间减少 35.0%
highlight.en: Same two recordings: 35.0% less transcoding time

question.zh: 如何让采集后的处理更快，同时保证原始数据和输出的一致性？
question.en: How can post-capture processing be faster while preserving source data and consistent outputs?

work.zh: 参与多相机录制、机械臂状态读取、后台任务队列和转码流程的开发与排查。
work.en: Work on multi-camera recording, robot-state reads, background queues, and transcoding development and diagnosis.

work.zh: 以相同封存录制对比不同转码并发，检查输出 MP4 哈希、时间戳和原始数据哈希。
work.en: Compare transcoding concurrency on the same sealed recordings, checking MP4 hashes, timestamps, and source-data hashes.

work.zh: 执行真实相机与静止机械臂状态读取测试，核对保存结果和解码帧数，并明确与运动跟随验收的区别。
work.en: Test real cameras alongside state reads from static arms, verify saved output and decoded frame counts, and distinguish this from motion-following acceptance.

experiment.zh: Windows 后台转码队列；同两条封存录制，共 3,090 帧，对比 4 路和 8 路并行。另一次真实静止设备读取测试完成 14 条录制，累计约 30 分钟。
experiment.en: A Windows background transcoding queue; 4 versus 8 parallel streams on the same two sealed recordings, totaling 3,090 frames. A separate real-device, static-arm read test produced 14 recordings over approximately 30 minutes.

label.zh: 静止读取测试的解码帧数
label.en: Decoded frames in the static-arm test

boundary.zh: 转码结果来自同两条录制的离线对比。静止设备读取测试产生 148 个派生 MP4；它验证了该测试范围内的采集与处理链路，没有验证机械臂运动跟随、机械控制性能或训练所需的视频与状态对齐。
boundary.en: The transcoding result is an offline comparison using two recordings. The static-arm read test produced 148 derived MP4s and validated capture and processing within that scope. It did not establish motion following, mechanical control performance, or training-grade video/state alignment.

reflection.zh: 数据工程的优化需要同时回答两个问题：有没有更快，以及产出的数据是否仍然可信。
reflection.en: For data-system optimization, I want to answer both questions: is it faster, and can the resulting data still be trusted?

title.zh: 多模态评测接入与协议诊断

category.zh: 评测工具 · 结果可信度

summary.zh: 参与多模态评测入口、任务配置和结果检查，区分“能出分”与“严格零异常”，让异常和协议差异留在记录里。
summary.en: I work on multimodal evaluation entry points, task configuration, and result checks, distinguishing functional scoring from strict, anomaly-free validation.

highlight.zh: 32 个入口：31 个功能出分，27 个严格零异常
highlight.en: 32 entries: 31 functionally scored, 27 passed strict checks

question.zh: 评测脚本输出了分数，是否就意味着结果可以直接比较？
question.en: Does a score from an evaluation script automatically mean the result is comparable?

work.zh: 参与任务适配、数据字段映射、推理调用和评分流程的连通性检查。
work.en: Help connect task adapters, dataset fields, inference calls, and scoring procedures.

work.zh: 保留协议差异、异常样本和覆盖情况，区分功能完成、正式覆盖与严格验收。
work.en: Record protocol differences, anomalous samples, and coverage, separating functional completion from full coverage and strict acceptance.

work.zh: 把可复用的任务配置、评分逻辑和审计说明与大型预测结果分开管理。
work.en: Keep reusable task configuration, scoring logic, and audit notes separate from large prediction artifacts.

experiment.zh: 一次 32 个评测入口的功能验证，各任务的测试范围不同。统计保留了异常项，不将功能出分自动归入严格通过。
experiment.en: A functional validation across 32 evaluation entries, with different tested scopes per benchmark. Anomalous entries remain visible rather than being counted as strict passes merely because a score was produced.

boundary.zh: 31 个功能出分入口中，4 个仍保留异常；另有 1 个入口待完成。任务覆盖范围并不一致，不能把这组数字写成 31 项完整、正式或可直接比较的榜单成绩。
boundary.en: Four of the 31 functionally completed entries retain anomalies; one additional entry remains pending. Coverage differs by task, so these are not 31 complete, formal, directly comparable benchmark results.

reflection.zh: 比分数本身更早需要确定的，是模型身份、样本范围、评分协议和异常处理。
reflection.en: Before interpreting a score, I want to know the model identity, sample scope, scoring protocol, and treatment of errors.

title.zh: DexEval 与云端模型服务工程

summary.zh: 参与模型评测平台及云端服务相关开发，把配置、提交、监控、结果审计和资源回收串成可跟进的实验流程。
summary.en: I contribute to evaluation-platform and cloud-serving work, connecting configuration, submission, monitoring, result auditing, and resource cleanup into a traceable experiment workflow.

highlight.zh: 关注一次实验的完整生命周期

question.zh: 如何让一次评测的配置、执行状态、产物和资源归属对应起来？
question.en: How can an evaluation's configuration, execution state, artifacts, and resource ownership stay connected?

work.zh: 参与评测工具与平台功能开发、配置核对和本地检查，结合已有工作流跟进云端执行。
work.en: Contribute to evaluation tools and platform features, check configuration locally, and follow cloud execution through established workflows.

work.zh: 按部署状态、健康检查、模型身份和真实推理请求逐层检查服务。
work.en: Check services through deployment state, health, model identity, and actual inference requests.

work.zh: 跟进运行日志和结果目录，核对 episode 覆盖、终态及归档，再处理当前实验的资源回收。
work.en: Follow logs and result directories, verify episode coverage, terminal state, and archival, and then clean up resources belonging to the current experiment.

experiment.zh: 工程实践覆盖本地功能检查、云端作业与推理服务跟进，以及实验结果整理；不同环节按各自验证范围记录。
experiment.en: The engineering work spans local checks, cloud jobs and inference-service monitoring, and result organization, with each stage documented at its own verification scope.

boundary.zh: 这里展示的是实习期间参与的工程工作与流程认识，不宣称独立负责整个评测平台，也不把本地测试通过等同于生产部署或物理机器人验收。
boundary.en: This describes contributions and engineering practices during an internship, not independent ownership of an entire platform. Passing local tests is distinct from deployment or physical-robot acceptance.

reflection.zh: 一个可用的评测工具，应该帮助人回答：现在运行到哪里、结果保存在哪里、还有哪些资源需要处理。
reflection.en: A useful evaluation tool should make three things clear: where the run stands, where its results are saved, and which resources still need attention.

title.zh: DM05 训练后回归与覆盖审计
title.en: DM05 post-training regression and coverage audits

category.zh: 训练与推理 · 回归验证

summary.zh: 围绕训练 checkpoint 执行评测与严格覆盖检查，把模型结果、系统异常和历史对比的适用条件分别记录。
summary.en: I run checkpoint evaluations with strict coverage checks, keeping policy outcomes, system errors, and the limits of historical comparisons distinct.

highlight.zh: 四套 LIBERO：2,000 个唯一 episode 完整覆盖
highlight.en: Four LIBERO suites: 2,000 unique episodes covered

question.zh: 一个训练后的 checkpoint 是否被完整评测？其结果支持什么结论？
question.en: Has a trained checkpoint been evaluated completely, and what conclusions does the result support?

work.zh: 参与训练后模型的推理检查、四套 LIBERO 评测及运行异常跟进。
work.en: Contribute to post-training inference checks, four-suite LIBERO evaluation, and investigation of run-time issues.

work.zh: 核对计划样本与实际唯一 episode，检查重复、缺失、越界和系统错误。
work.en: Compare planned samples with observed unique episodes, checking duplicates, omissions, out-of-range entries, and system errors.

work.zh: 整理 checkpoint、协议和评分结果的对应关系，避免将非受控历史对比描述成训练收益。
work.en: Keep checkpoint identity, protocol, and scores connected, avoiding improvement claims from uncontrolled historical comparisons.

experiment.zh: DM05 LoRA checkpoint 30k；LIBERO Spatial、Object、Goal、LIBERO-10 四套，每套 500 episodes。最终严格审计覆盖 2,000 个唯一 episode。
experiment.en: DM05 LoRA checkpoint 30k; LIBERO Spatial, Object, Goal, and LIBERO-10 with 500 episodes each. The final strict audit covers 2,000 unique episodes.

boundary.zh: 结果属于这个 checkpoint 和评测协议。历史基座结果并非同条件受控 A/B，因此不能据此声称 LoRA 训练带来了提分，也不将该值视为个人算法创新成果。
boundary.en: The result belongs to this checkpoint and protocol. The historical base-model result is not a matched, controlled A/B comparison, so it does not establish a gain from LoRA training or a personal algorithmic contribution.

reflection.zh: 训练、推理和评测需要一条连续的证据链；完整覆盖首先回答“测全了没有”，模型效果还需要另外的对照。
reflection.en: Training, inference, and evaluation need a continuous evidence trail. Full coverage first answers whether the evaluation is complete; model-quality conclusions require an additional controlled comparison.
